concepts.title: Infinite product of complex numbers or functions
concepts.description: The limit of the finite partial products ∏_{j=1}^N a_j as N→∞, when it exists; for functions the mode of convergence is specified, such as locally uniform convergence on the stated domain. Formal products mean stabilization of each coefficient instead of analytic convergence.

concepts.title: Z(g)-finite smooth function on a Lie group
concepts.description: A smooth complex function f on a real Lie group is Z(g)-finite when the span of zf, for z in the center of U(g⊗_R C), is finite-dimensional. The action differentiates right translations and extends to the enveloping algebra.

concepts.title: Integral basis of a number field
concepts.description: A finite Z-module basis of the ring of integers O_F: every algebraic integer in F is a unique integer linear combination of the basis elements.

concepts.title: Element integral over a commutative ring
concepts.description: For a ring inclusion R⊂A, an element a∈A is integral over R if it satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in R.

concepts.title: Integral Heisenberg group for scalar-index Jacobi forms
concepts.description: For λ,μ in Z^g and κ in Z, use the triples (λ,μ,κ) with product (λ+λ′,μ+μ′,κ+κ′+λ·μ′−μ·λ′). The dot products are the finite coordinate sums; this specifies the integral normalization used in the scalar-index Jacobi slash action.

concepts.title: Integral Jacobi group
concepts.description: The semidirect product of Sp(2g,Z) with the integral Heisenberg group, where the symplectic factor acts on the λ,μ coordinates and fixes the center; its action on H_g×C^g is the one used in Jacobi modular and elliptic transformation laws.

concepts.title: Kernel of an integral operator
concepts.description: For a measure space, a measurable function K(x,y) representing an operator by (Tf)(x)=∫K(x,y)f(y)dμ(y), on the specified class of functions where the expression is defined. A square-integrable kernel is an element of L² of the product measure space.

concepts.title: Integrated operator of a unitary representation
concepts.description: For f∈L¹(G), the bounded operator π(f) determined weakly by ⟨π(f)v,w⟩=∫_G f(g)⟨π(g)v,w⟩dg. This uses a fixed Haar measure and a unitary representation of a locally compact group.

concepts.title: Invariant gauge form on a smooth affine algebraic group
concepts.description: A nowhere-zero left-invariant algebraic differential form ω of degree d=dim_F Lie(G): in coordinates it is an element of Λ^d Ω_(O(G)/F) whose value at every geometric point is nonzero. It is defined over F, and its invariant choices differ by F×.

concepts.title: Irreducible unitary representation
concepts.description: A nonzero unitary representation with no closed invariant complex linear subspace other than0 and the whole Hilbert space.

concepts.title: Jacobi theta function with characteristics
concepts.description: For fixed real a,b, θ[a,b](τ,z)=∑_{n∈Z}exp(πi(n+a)²τ+2πi(n+a)(z+b)), with Im(τ)>0. The three even half-characteristics (1/2,0),(0,0),(0,1/2) give the standard θ₂,θ₃,θ₄ conventions.

concepts.title: K-finite function under right translation
concepts.description: For a subgroup K of G, a complex function f on G is K-finite if the functions x↦f(xk), k∈K, span a finite-dimensional complex vector space. In automorphic applications K is compact.

concepts.title: Kähler differentials of an algebra
concepts.description: For a commutative F-algebra A, the A-module Ω_(A/F) generated by symbols da, a∈A, subject to additivity, F-linearity and d(ab)=a·db+b·da.

concepts.title: Kronecker symbol with denominator2
concepts.description: For an integer a, (a/2)=0 if a is even, and (a/2)=(−1)^((a²−1)/8) if a is odd; equivalently it is 1 for a≡±1 modulo8 and −1 for a≡±3 modulo8.

concepts.title: Krull topology on an infinite Galois group
concepts.description: On Gal(L/F), the subgroup fixing each finite intermediate extension E/F is an open neighbourhood of the identity; their cosets form a basis. For an absolute Galois group take L=F^sep.

concepts.title: L²-space on an automorphic quotient
concepts.description: Complex square-integrable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality on Γ∖G, for a discrete subgroup Γ of a unimodular locally compact group G and the quotient Haar measure; the inner product is ∫_(Γ∖G)f·conj(h).

concepts.title: Least common multiple of integers
concepts.description: For nonzero integers a₁,…,a_r, the least positive integer divisible by every a_i.

concepts.title: Lie algebra over a field
concepts.description: A vector space with a bilinear bracket [x,y] satisfying [x,x]=0 and [x,[y,z]]+[y,[z,x]]+[z,[x,y]]=0.
